business_summary.text: SEDEMAC Mechatronics designs and supplies control-intensive electronic control units (ECUs) to vehicle and industrial OEMs in India, the US and Europe.

call_memory.quote: In FY26, we sold more than 3.9 million of this control intensive ECUs, which was more than 60% compared to FY25.

call_memory.statement: In FY26, SEDEMAC sold more than 3.9 million control-intensive ECUs.

lab.quote: So our FY26 revenue was 1,058 crore, the first time that we have crossed 1,000 crore in revenue, highest ever. And it was a 61% up compared to FY25 revenue.

call_memory.quote: So our FY26 revenue was 1,058 crore, the first time that we have crossed 1,000 crore in revenue, highest ever. And it was a 61% up compared to FY25 revenue.

call_memory.statement: The number of two, three-wheelers produced with ISG in India was 8.4 million in FY26 compared to 5.1 million three years back.

call_memory.statement: SEDEMAC ISG ECU is going to get introduced on 3 popular motorcycle models of three of the top four OEMs, with two launches expected in Q1 and the third launch expected in Q4 of FY27.

And as a result of that, some RM cost increase is likely and it will, you know, it is expected to put a mild pressure on EBITDA percentage.

call_points.text: Commodity inflation and semiconductor supply tightening raised raw-material cost and cut EBITDA margin a bit in Q1FY27.
ISG ECU introduction is underway on variants of three top-10 motorcycle models of three of the top four OEMs.
Two wet-magneto launches were expected in Q1FY27; one is in production and the second is imminent.
A third wet-magneto launch is expected in Q4FY27.
E2W MCU ramp-up is in play after start of production in Q3FY26.
ISG ECUs for export three-wheelers started production in Q4FY26 and are ramping up.
The US hurricane season could affect the US home-standby generator market; no adverse effect seen so far.
ISG ECUs will be introduced on three popular top-10 motorcycle models across three top-four OEMs in FY27.
MF3 plant will become the mother ECU plant offering 3x space (120,000 sq ft) with shipments starting Q2FY27.
MF4 plant dedicated to electric machines / motors will begin dispatches from Q3FY27.
Acquired land in Shoolagiri for future shipments to OEMs located in southern India.
Tightening semiconductor supply chain and commodity inflation expected to put mild pressure on EBITDA margin.
Commercial vehicle after-treatment controller SOP is on track for H2FY27.
Every ₹100 Cr incremental revenue requires roughly ₹20 Cr fixed asset capex and ₹12-15 Cr working capital.
Company plans to conduct investor earnings calls every six months rather than every quarter.
Sensorless ISG adoption growing, supplying 3 of top 4 2W OEMs in India.
Semiconductor supply tightening and raw material cost inflation may cause mild EBITDA margin pressure in FY27.

operating_notes.text: Cumulatively sold >12 million control-intensive ECUs to vehicle and industrial OEMs.
New Labour Codes implementation resulted in a one-time employee benefit provision of ₹0.81 Cr in Q4FY26.
Power tool market represents >300 million units globally; motor controller pricing scales primarily with kilowatt rating.
FY26 total 2/3W produced in India with ISG reached 8.4 million units, up from 5.1 million units three years earlier.
Control-intensive ECUs sold in TTM Q1FY27 were 4,201,939, against 2,747,383 in TTM Q1FY26, with over 13 million sold cumulatively.

SEDEMAC released its FY26 investor presentation highlighting 61% revenue growth to ₹1,058 Cr and 119% PAT growth to ₹104 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹287.71 Cr, net profit ₹32.08 Cr.
SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4FY26 on May 18, 2026, via its website.
SEDEMAC reported transcript of maiden post-IPO earnings call outlining FY27 ISG motorcycle launches and capacity ramp-ups at MF3 and MF4.
Received Tamil Nadu GST show cause notice demanding ₹2.35 Cr (tax ₹2.14 Cr, penalty ₹0.21 Cr) for FY23 and FY24; contesting by June 9, 2026.
SEDEMAC Mechatronics promoter Anaykumar Avinash Joshi submitted a declaration under Regulation 31(4) confirming zero share encumbrance for FY26.

SEDEMAC's July 2026 investor presentation reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹310 Cr (+43% YoY), EBITDA of ₹60 Cr (+31%) and PAT of ₹33 Cr (+95%), with management flagging input-cost pressure and guiding to flat-to-better EBITDA margin for the rest of FY27.
